name: browser-use
headline: agentfs-claude for integrated code execution
short_description: Run Claude Code or Codex within a virtualized file system using AgentFS, orchestrated by LlamaIndex Workflows. Ideal for operations teams automating code generation and file system tasks. Integrates with TypeScript-based workflows for automation.
author: run-llama

sections.overview:
AgentFS-Claude integrates Claude Code or Codex with a fully-virtualized file system orchestrated by LlamaIndex Workflows. The skill exposes filesystem operations through an MCP server, allowing agents to read, write, edit, and list files within AgentFS rather than the real file system. It supports parsing unstructured files like PDFs and Word documents through LlamaCloud integration, with all text-based files indexed in a LibSQL database. This creates a sandboxed environment where coding agents can safely perform file operations, ideal for operations teams automating code generation, documentation tasks, and file system workflows.
Automated code generation and refactoring with file system isolation
Processing and analyzing PDFs and Word documents through an agent interface
Building sandboxed workflows that combine file operations with web search and task management
Operations automation that requires reading and modifying multiple files safely
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/run-llama/agentfs-claude`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
